tutorial.field: These are the field cards. A played hand card captures a field card of the same month (flower). When two cards match, you choose which to take.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. Playing a card captures a same-month field card, then draws one card from the stock.
tutorial.info: Go-Stop is a two-player Korean capture game played with the 48-card hanafuda deck. Captured cards are scored in five categories (Gwang / Godori / Tti / Yeol / Pi). When you reach the target score you choose go (continue, raising the stakes) or stop (bank the points). Calling go risks the gwang-bak, pi-bak, and go-bak penalties if your opponent turns the tables.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
